output_language.contract_text: Write the reader-facing manuscript in natural, idiomatic English (spelling: en-US). Compose directly in English — do not write in another language and translate, and do not imitate another language's grammar or idioms. Use standard English article usage, word order, and dialogue punctuation (curly quotes, em dashes, the ellipsis character). Render address terms, titles, and formality the way natural English speakers of this setting would speak them (see the dialogue register notes) — never as transliterated honorific suffixes attached to names. Use only the approved romanized or preserved terms listed in the terminology notes; everything else is plain English. Do not produce translation-like English.
output_language.numbers_style: words to nine, numerals from 10; ranks and levels as written (F-rank, Lv. 3)

translation_markers.note: Article omission before singular count nouns (heuristic; grammar service refines)
Honorific suffix attached to a name

translation_markers.pattern: \b(As expected of|It can'?t be helped|This guy|That person)\b

calque_phrases: My heart rose to my throat

anchors.5: Reads as written by a fluent English author; idioms and collocations are natural.
anchors.3: Occasional stiff phrasing or unidiomatic collocation.
anchors.1: Frequent unnatural phrasing; reads as translated.

anchors.5: No article omission, calques, honorific morphemes, or source-language word order.
anchors.3: A few calques or odd article choices.
anchors.1: Pervasive calques, dropped articles, transliterated honorifics.

anchors.5: Formality and address terms are rendered as natural English speakers would use them.
anchors.3: Register is right but rendered stiffly.
anchors.1: Formality expressed through literal translations of foreign politeness forms.

anchors.5: Short, varied sentences; clear who does what.
Plain, punchy diction suited to serialized reading.
anchors.1: Metaphor chains and elevated diction dominate.

calibration.notes: Starting values; calibrate on the contrast set and reviewer overrides (ADR-0029).
